summary: Directus is a headless CMS / data platform whose API exposes CRUD over user-defined collections plus ~30 system tables (users, roles, policies, access, permissions, files, folders, flows, dashboards, presets, settings, shares, versions, notifications, comments, activity, sessions, extensions, oauth clients). The generic ItemsService engine plus per-entity services write and read persisted rows; auth manages sessions and user status.
